top_signals.title: Traders’ Cost of Hedging Against Big Treasuries Rally Is Soaring
top_signals.summary: The cost of options hedges against more gains in Treasuries surged to its highest level since March on Thursday, as investors sought the safety of US government bonds following a spike in oil prices and a deepening fiscal crisis in France.

top_signals.title: RBC’s New Canada Stock Strategy Chief Sets TSX Target at 38,600
top_signals.summary: Royal Bank of Canada’s capital markets division named Sara Mahaffy as head of Canadian equity strategy, marking the first time in a decade it’s had a dedicated strategist covering the domestic stock market.

top_signals.title: New Zealand Cost Crisis Drives Election Vows to Rein In Business
top_signals.summary: In New Zealand, the rising price of everyday items is sobering: bread costs 64% more than three years ago, butter is up 57% and electricity 27%. Hikes like these are causing politicians across the spectrum to propose radical market interventions to improve competition and lower costs ahead of next month’s election.
